method: Wash and dry the shredded lettuce and cucumber; shred the leaves and slice the cucumber thinly. Reserve most of the leaves and any excess cucumber for a side salad so the wholemeal pitta can close.
Choose firm tofu labelled ready to eat. Drain and pat it dry, then cut it into thin slices; keep it chilled until assembly.
Use the measured lemon yoghurt dressing as a ready-to-eat sauce or dressing. Keep chilled sauces refrigerated until assembly.
Use ready-to-eat wholemeal pitta. Cut it into two halves and carefully open the pockets.

Combine the prepared filling with the measured lemon yoghurt dressing. Add a small handful of the prepared leaves and some sliced cucumber. Spoon a manageable layer of filling into each pitta pocket. Serve all remaining filling and vegetables alongside as the side salad.
Eat now, or put the meal and any side salad into a covered container and refrigerate promptly. Eat within 24 hours and follow any shorter ingredient use-by date; keep it chilled until eating.
